title: A set operator on a Numeric operator
question: Do ForAllValues and ForAnyValue work with Numeric operators? AWS's tables only show String, Bool and ARN examples. The analyzer assumes they do: a judgment call.

cases.name: for_any_value_numeric_less_than
cases.description: ForAnyValue:NumericLessThan s3:max-keys 10, with the values 5 and 20.

readings.ALLOW: set operators work with Numeric operators, as the analyzer assumes
